payload.blocks: Phase 5 (the skill wiring that makes planning, implement, validating and shaping call locate). Phase 1 does not wait on this.
payload.headline: In projects without an authority model, should the skills skip fgos authority locate the way they skip impact analysis?

parts.cause: The independent review of branch component-authority-doors/p01 found it. The lead checked that apps/fgos/src/wiring/authority.rs loads the model from the project root, and that package.json files lists no packages/component-authority path, so no release ships a model.

options.cost: A few lines of skill text and a model-exists check in scripts/plan-contract-check.mjs, inside phase 5's footprint.
options.does: The skills call locate only when the project has a model. Without one they record 'authority: inactive' and go on, the same as the impact-analysis gate in AGENTS.md. The plan-contract Authority-map rule applies only where a model exists.
options.gain: Planning keeps working in every project, and the fgOS repository gets the full rule. A project can adopt the rule later by adding its own model.
options.harm: Other projects get no duplicate-door protection until they write a model.
options.label: A. Locate is a gated capability

options.cost: A new packaging and init item; this plan's footprint does not cover it.
options.does: Releases carry a starter model, and fgctl init seeds an empty model into every project, so locate always runs.
options.gain: The same rule everywhere, from day one.
options.harm: An empty model makes locate return nothing, so the rule is noise until the project fills it in. It also touches packaging and init, outside this plan.
options.label: B. Ship and seed a model for every project

parts.recommendation: A: it follows the existing impact-analysis gate pattern, keeps mission #1 projects unblocked, and stays inside phase 5.

scope.allows: Phase 5 to word the skill and plan-contract requirement as gated on a present model, and to make plan-contract-check skip the Authority-map rule where no model exists.
scope.forbids: Changing packaging, init or the model itself, and changing how locate behaves inside the fgOS repository.

parts.what: fgos authority locate reads <project root>/packages/component-authority/model/. Only the fgOS source repository has that model. In any other project that uses fgOS, the verb fails with 'model file missing'. As written, phase 5 makes the coding skills require locate everywhere, so planning in those projects would hit an error.
